title: A Time for Everything
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about the right hour for things, and Wren the Wonderer is the Traveler who stops to ask what a rainy afternoon might be the right time for instead of fussing that it is not the one she wanted.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she thinks about the right time for things. In Wren’s world today: Wren wanted to play outside, but it was pouring rain. Instead of fussing, she wondered, “Maybe this is a time to stay cozy inside.” So she read books and built a fort, and when the sun came out later, it was the perfect time to splash in puddles. Just like the wise teacher said there’s a time for everything, Wren learned to trust each season’s time.
